Idle.prompt: A person bounces lightly in a boxing fighting stance, guard up, weight shifting.

Step_In.prompt: A fighter takes a quick step forward in a fighting stance, keeping the guard up.

Jab.prompt: A boxer throws a quick left jab and snaps the hand back to the guard.

Cross.prompt: A boxer throws a straight right punch, rotating the hips, and returns to guard.

Hook.prompt: A boxer throws a left hook, turning the whole body, and resets.

Elbow_Strike.prompt: A muay thai fighter throws a horizontal elbow strike and recovers.

Knee_Strike.prompt: A muay thai fighter drives a rising knee strike forward and sets the foot down.

Front_Kick.prompt: A martial artist throws a fast front snap kick and pulls the leg back.

Roundhouse_Kick.prompt: A martial artist throws a powerful roundhouse kick with the right leg and recovers.

Spinning_Kick.prompt: A martial artist performs a spinning back kick and lands in a fighting stance.

Rising_Uppercut.prompt: A fighter crouches, then explodes upward with a rising uppercut and lands.

Jump_Kick.prompt: A fighter leaps forward into a flying kick and lands in a crouch.

Aerial_Knee.prompt: A fighter jumps and drives a flying knee, then lands.

Aerial_Spin.prompt: A fighter jumps and spins in the air with a spinning kick, then lands.

Axe_Kick.prompt: A fighter jumps and brings the leg up and down in an axe kick, landing in a crouch.

Landing_Recovery.prompt: A fighter lands from a jump in a deep crouch and rises into a fighting stance.

Focus_Idle.prompt: A fighter holds a low wide stance with open hands near the chest, focused, breathing, weight shifting.

One_Hand_Cast.prompt: A fighter pulls the right hand back, then thrusts it forward with an open palm, casting a spell.

Two_Hand_Forward_Cast.prompt: A fighter gathers both hands at the chest, then pushes both palms forward in a powerful cast.

Overhead_Cast.prompt: A fighter raises both hands overhead, rises on the toes, then slams the hands down and forward.

Low_Cast.prompt: A fighter drops into a deep crouch and sweeps a hand low along the ground in a casting motion.

Palm_Thrust_Cast.prompt: A fighter lunges forward with a palm thrust, fingers spread, casting a spell, then recovers.

Sigil_Hand_Motion.prompt: A fighter traces a circular sigil in the air with one hand, standing in a low wide stance.

Step_In_Cast.prompt: A fighter steps forward and casts a spell with an outstretched hand.

Backstep_Cast.prompt: A fighter hops backward and casts a spell with an outstretched hand.

Air_Cast.prompt: A fighter jumps and casts a spell with one hand in mid-air, then lands in a crouch.

Cast_Cancel_Recovery.prompt: A fighter cuts a cast short, pulls the hands back and drops into a defensive crouch, then rises.

Return_To_Stance.prompt: A fighter relaxes from a casting pose and settles into a boxing fighting stance.

Ready_Stance.prompt: A boxer bounces on the spot in a ready stance, hands up, knees bent.

Head_Weave_Left.prompt: A boxer weaves the head and body to the left to dodge a punch, then returns to the guard.

Head_Weave_Right.prompt: A boxer weaves the head and body to the right to dodge a punch, then returns to the guard.

Duck_And_Rise.prompt: A boxer ducks low under a punch and rises back to the guard.

Slip_Back.prompt: A boxer leans the upper body backward to slip a punch, then returns.

Bob_And_Weave_Combo.prompt: A boxer bobs and weaves left and right, ducking low in a continuous combination.

Pivot_Evade.prompt: A fighter pivots on the front foot to sidestep an attack and faces the opponent again.

Crouch_Feint.prompt: A fighter drops into a quick crouching feint and snaps back up.

Advance_Weave.prompt: A boxer advances forward while weaving the head left and right.

Retreat_Weave.prompt: A boxer retreats backward while weaving the head left and right.

Low_Sway_Recovery.prompt: A fighter sways low to one side with a hand near the ground and recovers upright.

Reset_To_Guard.prompt: A fighter settles from a crouch into a balanced boxing guard.

Calm_Combat_Stance.prompt: A fighter stands calmly in a relaxed combat stance, breathing slowly.

Berserk_Activation.prompt: A fighter crouches clutching the body, then rises with clenched fists and roars, transforming in rage.

Roar_Pose.prompt: A fighter throws the head back and roars with arms spread wide and fists clenched, in a wide stance.

Power_Surge_Breath.prompt: A fighter crouches and takes a deep breath, then expands the chest and clenches both fists, surging with power.

Feral_Guard.prompt: A hunched feral fighter in a wide low stance with clawed hands swaying menacingly.

Lunge_Start.prompt: A fighter crouches low, coils the body, and launches into a ferocious lunge forward.

Heavy_Step_In.prompt: A rage-filled fighter takes heavy stomping steps forward, shoulders hunched.

Wild_Swing_Windup.prompt: A fighter winds up a wild haymaker, swinging the arm up overhead and back.

Grounding_Recover.prompt: A fighter crouches with both hands on the ground to steady themselves, then rises into a stance.

Berserk_Idle_Loop.prompt: A raging hunched fighter pants and sways in a wide low stance, arms hanging forward.

Guard_Impact.prompt: A fighter in a guard is hit on the blocking arms and is pushed back slightly, then holds the guard.

Light_Hit_Reaction.prompt: A fighter is hit lightly in the face, the head snaps to the side, then recovers.

Heavy_Body_Hit.prompt: A fighter is hit hard in the stomach, doubles over, and slowly straightens.

Head_Hit_Snapback.prompt: A fighter is punched in the jaw, the head snaps back, and the body staggers.

Stagger_Backward.prompt: A fighter staggers backward in several unsteady steps, arms flailing, then regains balance.

Stagger_Forward.prompt: A fighter stumbles forward hunched over after being hit from behind, then recovers.

Knockback.prompt: A fighter is hit by a powerful blow and is thrown backward through the air, landing on the back.

Launch_Reaction.prompt: A fighter is hit by an uppercut and is launched high into the air, then falls to the ground.

Airborne_Tumble.prompt: A fighter tumbles through the air after being launched, rotating, and lands.

Falling_Reaction.prompt: A fighter falls backward and crumples onto the ground.

Hard_Landing.prompt: A fighter hits the ground hard on the back, rolls over, and pushes up onto hands and knees.

Knockdown_Crumple.prompt: A fighter's knees buckle and they collapse sideways onto the ground.

Get_Up_Recovery.prompt: A fighter lying on the ground pushes up, kneels on one knee and stands into a fighting stance.

Dazed_Stunned.prompt: A dazed fighter sways on the spot holding the head, groggy and unsteady.

Braced_Recovery.prompt: A fighter recovers from a hit by bracing in a crouch, then rises to a stance.
